summary: Backend regression for YouBelong user-selectable status system. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_status_system.py (17 pytest cases) covering: /api/status-options shape & 5 options, POST set/GET round-trip for all 4 active codes, invalid-status 400, status=null clear, auto-fallback when no chosen status, stale (>30 min) chosen 'looking_to_chat' falls back to auto, chosen 'offline' honoured even when recent AND when stale, privacy='invisible' overrides chosen status to Offline, flutter notification copy sweep ('is looking to chat' in title, default message 'would like to chat 🦋'), and regression on /community/today, /games/wordsearch/{catalog,daily}, frankie demo-login. Result: 17/17 PASSED. One small clarification needed for the main agent: the review prompt referenced 'POST /api/users/{uid}/flutter' but the actual implementation lives at 'POST /api/flutters/send' (verified via grep of @api.post decorators); the test exercises the real route. No code fixes were needed — implementation is correct.
action_items: Heads-up only (NOT a bug): the review request listed the flutter route as 'POST /api/users/{uid}/flutter', but the actual implementation is 'POST /api/flutters/send'. Both copy changes ('is looking to chat' notification title; 'would like to chat 🦋' default message) are correctly applied in server.py:2677,2684 — verified end-to-end via Mongo notification doc.

Minor style nit (no fix required): server.py defines `_status_from` at line 900 which references `STATUS_LABELS` defined later at line 946. Python resolves this at call-time so it works, but moving the `STATUS_LABELS` dict ABOVE `_status_from` would make the module read top-down and avoid a forward reference that could trip a static analyser.
Optional: consider exposing `status_updated_at` in the GET /users/{uid}/status response so the frontend can show 'set 5 min ago' badges; currently not returned.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:900-942 (_status_from) — logic is clean: invisible→Offline short-circuits before any chosen check; explicit `chosen == 'offline'` branch bypasses staleness; 30-min window is enforced correctly via timedelta. Auto-fallback bands (120s online / 24h active_today / 7d recent / else offline) all verified.
server.py:945-952 (STATUS_LABELS) — exactly 5 entries with consistent {label, code, emoji} shape; codes match the picker spec.
server.py:959-967 (set_user_status) — correctly validates against STATUS_LABELS, supports null clear, refreshes last_seen_at on set (so the chosen status is immediately within the 30-min window).
server.py:976-981 (user_status GET) — returns 404 for unknown user, projects only the 3 needed fields from Mongo, defaults privacy to 'everyone'.
server.py:2677,2684 (send_flutter) — both copy sweeps applied ('would like to chat 🦋' default, 'is looking to chat' notification title).

success_rate.frontend: not tested (out of scope per request)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Autouse fixture resets frankie's status to null + privacy to 'everyone' + last_seen_at to now BEFORE and AFTER each test. Flutter test cleans up the inserted flutter doc and the maggie-side notification it creates. No extra users / completions created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_status_system.py uses synchronous PyMongo for DB inspection + setup (back-dating last_seen_at to simulate staleness), and python-dotenv to read MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env. The flutter route is /api/flutters/send (NOT /api/users/{uid}/flutter as the review prompt suggested). The autouse reset fixture is critical because each test mutates frankie's status; do not remove it. If you add coffee-lounge WS auto-status tests later, frankie's status_prior field is also unset by the fixture so prior-status restore logic on leave will not bleed across tests.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found — feature works as specified. One non-bug clarification: the review request listed flutter as POST /api/users/{uid}/flutter, but the actual route is POST /api/flutters/send (verified by grep of @api.post). The copy changes themselves are present and tested via the real endpoint.
